title: Regional 2025 grid generation mix excluding biomass
what: renewable share of generation without biomass (%)

reader_questions.question: What share of generation is renewable when only wind, solar and hydro count (biomass excluded), in %?
Which generation sources make up the non-biomass renewable share?
Why did the figure have to be revised from the prior draft?
reader_questions.expected: The prior draft counted biomass as renewable, inflating the renewable share.
